title: Slack: channel posts, rate limits, escaping and reader DMs
description:
**Reworked 2026-11-04:** Ryan reversed the architecture. No new AWS account and no central service; see docs/notifications-plan.md in AnthusAI/Caducus.

**Milestone:** Later, coarse

**Goal.** Coarse until M3 ships. Delivery through the `Channel` interface.

**Build.**
FIFO SQS in each site's stack with message group per channel, because Slack allows about one message per second per channel with short bursts. On 429 wait for `Retry-After`. Escape `&`, `<`, `>` in every title and reader text before building mrkdwn, so `<!channel>`, `<!here>` and `<@U...>` cannot be formed from a headline; use `plain_text` where blocks allow. Test with hostile headlines. Site name and icon inside the message. Reader DMs: pass the user id as `channel`; Slack answers `channel_not_found` if the app cannot reach them, in practice meaning the reader's workspace must have the app, and the page says so. Requires Google sign-in, needing a public-reader site in Prospectus: today Shipped and Machines on Machines.

**Acceptance.**
Spec'd when started: a headline `<!channel> hi` shows literally and pings nobody.

**Depends on:** kanbus-ae4094, kanbus-726078
